_version: 2026-10-17 v2 (verified against 1966.gov.tw pages and MOHW regulation text)

say_instead_meets_conditions.zh: 您符合「申請」長照服務的身分條件。是否能使用補助、可用多少，由照管專員到府評估決定（需評為第2級以上）。
say_instead_meets_conditions.en: Your parent meets the conditions to APPLY. Whether benefits are granted, and how much, is decided by the government care manager's home assessment (level 2 or higher required).

say_instead_not_meeting.zh: 依您提供的資料，目前不符合申請身分條件。仍可撥打1966確認，或使用社區據點（巷弄長照站、社區照顧關懷據點）的預防及延緩失能服務。
say_instead_not_meeting.en: Based on your answers, your parent does not currently meet the conditions to apply. You can still call 1966 to confirm, or use community stations for prevention and delay-of-disability programs.

amounts_without_level.zh: 尚未評估前，以下是各等級的官方額度表，實際等級由評估決定。
amounts_without_level.en: Before the assessment, this is the official table for every level; the actual level is set by the assessment.

eligibility._rule: Must be assessed by the city/county Long-Term Care Management Center (照管中心) at care-need level 2 or above, AND meet one of the identity conditions below (辦法第2條; 1966 apply page).

identity_conditions.zh: 50歲以上失智症者；自115年1月1日起新增49歲以下失智症者
identity_conditions.en: Dementia aged 50+; since 2026-01-01 also dementia aged 49 and under (so: dementia at any age)

identity_conditions.zh: 失能身心障礙者（領有身心障礙證明）
identity_conditions.en: Person with a disability certificate who has care needs

identity_conditions.zh: 自115年1月1日起：健保急性後期整合照護計畫(PAC)收案對象
identity_conditions.en: Since 2026-01-01: enrolled in the NHI Post-Acute Care (PAC) program

levels.level1: Level 1 receives no benefits (辦法第7條)

if_not_eligible.zh: 可使用社區照顧關懷據點、巷弄長照站、文化健康站等健康促進、共餐、預防及延緩失能服務
if_not_eligible.en: Community care stations offer health promotion, shared meals and prevention/delay-of-disability programs

income_does_not_reduce_benefit.zh: 長照服務不會因為家庭經濟狀況打折，只有自付額度的差別
income_does_not_reduce_benefit.en: Benefits are not reduced by household income — only the copay changes

application_process.zh: 申請：撥打1966、聯絡當地照管中心、住院期間聯絡出院準備銜接長照服務小組，或線上申請
application_process.en: Apply: call 1966, contact the local Long-Term Care Management Center, ask the hospital's discharge planning team while still in hospital, or apply online

application_process.zh: 到府評估：照管專員評估後確認長照需要等級及給付額度
application_process.en: Home assessment: a care manager assesses and sets the care-need level and benefit amounts

application_process.zh: 擬定照顧計畫：與A單位個案管理員討論服務項目並連結服務
application_process.en: Care plan: discuss services with the A-unit case manager, who links providers

application_process.zh: 接受服務：由長照特約單位提供服務，民眾只付部分負擔
application_process.en: Receive services from contracted providers; you pay only the copay

discharge_planning.zh: 出院準備銜接長照服務：醫院於出院前完成長照需要等級評估及媒合服務。至114年底242家醫院參與，出院到銜接長照平均由51天降至4天，115年目標2天。
discharge_planning.en: Hospital discharge planning: the hospital completes the LTC assessment and matches services BEFORE discharge. 242 hospitals take part (end of 2025); average time from discharge to services fell from 51 days to 4 days, target 2 days in 2026.

tip.zh: 若仍在住院，請在出院前向護理站詢問「出院準備服務」
tip.en: If your parent is still in hospital, ask the ward nurse for 'discharge planning service (出院準備服務)' before discharge

monthly_care_cap_ntd._category: 照顧及專業服務 (home care, day care, family day care, small multi-function, professional services, community transport BD03)

carryover.zh: 照顧及專業服務、交通接送額度以六個月為一期，剩餘額度得保留於照顧計畫核定當月起算六個月內使用，期滿歸零（辦法第12條；衛部顧字第1141960552號）
carryover.en: Care/professional and transport quotas run in 6-month periods: unused amounts can be used within 6 months counted from the month the care plan was approved, then reset to zero.

no_transfer.zh: 四類額度不得互相流用
no_transfer.en: The four benefit pots cannot be moved between each other.

over_cap.zh: 超過額度部分全額自費
over_cap.en: Anything above the cap is fully self-paid.

reassessment.zh: A單位個管員每6個月家訪檢視照顧計畫；身體狀況改變可申請複評。等級提高自核定當月1日生效；等級降低自次月1日生效
reassessment.en: The case manager reviews the plan by home visit every 6 months; request a reassessment if the condition changes. A higher level applies from the 1st of the approval month; a lower level from the 1st of the next month.

inactivity.zh: 連續3個月未使用服務可能被結案（臺中市作業實務，各縣市可能不同）
inactivity.en: No service use for 3 months may lead to case closure (Taichung practice; may differ by city)

professional_services.zh: 專業服務(復能)：同一服務目標不超過12次（原則每週至多1次），6個月內完成；同代碼新目標需間隔90天
professional_services.en: Professional (reablement) services: max 12 sessions per goal (normally up to once a week), completed within 6 months; a new goal under the same code needs a 90-day gap

examples.zh: 臥床或長期活動受限照護
居家環境安全或無障礙空間規劃指導

professional_services._note: Prices include the copay; these come out of the monthly care & professional cap.

medical_DA01.zh: 往返居家至醫療院所就醫、定期復健或透析的交通接送；每趟價格由地方政府公告
medical_DA01.en: Trips between home and hospital/clinic for medical visits, regular rehab or dialysis; per-trip price set by the local government

zone4: remote/indigenous townships e.g. 新北市烏來區

community_BD03.zh: 社區式交通接送（往返日照中心、巷弄長照站、失智據點、輔具中心等）屬照顧及專業服務額度；每趟一般區115元、離島及原民區140元；10公里內
community_BD03.en: Community transport (to day care, care stations, dementia sites, device centers) comes out of the care & professional cap; NT$115 per trip (NT$140 in remote/indigenous areas); within 10 km

cycle.zh: 每三年給付一次，自照顧計畫核定之日起算；三年內不得更換組別
cycle.en: One amount per 3-year period, counted from the care plan approval date; the group cannot be changed within the period

group1.zh: 傳統輔具(E碼)及居家無障礙改善(F碼)
group1.en: Traditional devices (E codes) and home modifications (F codes)

group2.zh: 新增智慧科技輔具租賃(移位、移動、沐浴排泄、居家照顧床、安全看視)，另含便器椅/洗澡椅、單點拐杖、助行器；居家無障礙改善三年最高2萬元
group2.en: Adds smart-device rental (transfer, mobility, bathing/toileting, care beds, safety monitoring) plus commode/shower chair, single-point canes, walker; home modification max NT$20,000 per 3 years

prior_use_rules.zh: 115年6月30日以前已獲第一組給付者，須自該照顧計畫核定日起滿三年後，才能申請第二組
prior_use_rules.en: Anyone who received Group 1 benefits on or before 2026-06-30 must wait 3 years from that care plan's approval date before applying for Group 2
prior_use_rules.example: Approved 2023-06-26 → Group 1 only until 2026-06-25; Group 2 from 2026-06-26

prior_use_rules.zh: 三年期間內額度提前用完，不能提前改用第二組
prior_use_rules.en: If the 3-year amount runs out early, you cannot switch early to Group 2

prior_use_rules.zh: 三年期間內已使用的金額會從額度中扣除，只能使用剩餘額度
prior_use_rules.en: Amounts already used in the current 3-year period are deducted; only the remainder is available

prior_use_rules.zh: 同一輔具或同一處無障礙改善未達最低使用年限者，不得重複補助
prior_use_rules.en: The same device, or a modification at the same spot, cannot be subsidized again before its minimum service life ends

prior_use_rules.zh: 持身障證明者已依身障規定購置或租賃相同輔具且未達最低使用年限者，不得再以長照重複申請
prior_use_rules.en: If a disability-certificate holder already got the same device under the disability device subsidy and it is within its minimum service life, it cannot be claimed again under LTC

process.zh: 照管專員評估有輔具需求→轉介輔具資源中心或復健醫事機構完成輔具評估報告書→持報告至特約藥局/醫療器材行購買或租賃；自113年1月1日起全面代償墊付，民眾只付部分負擔
process.en: Care manager identifies the need → referral to a device resource center or rehab provider for an assessment report → buy or rent at a contracted pharmacy/medical supply shop with the report. Since 2024-01-01 the shop bills the government directly, so you pay only your copay.

requires.zh: 須有家庭照顧者；若已依身心障礙者權益保障法使用臨時及短期照顧，或其他法令另有規定者不適用
requires.en: Requires a family caregiver. Not available if already using short-term/temporary care under the disability rights law, or where other laws provide otherwise

prices_ntd.zh: 日間照顧中心喘息－全日
日間照顧中心喘息－半日
小規模多機能夜間喘息

respite._tip: Show how far the yearly cap goes, e.g. 32,340 ÷ 2,310 = 14 days of residential respite, or 25 full days at day care, or 42 two-hour home visits.

type1.zh: 第一類：低收入戶、中低收入戶，或符合中低收入老人生活津貼發給辦法第5條第1項第1款者
type1.en: Type 1: registered low-income OR middle-to-low-income households, or seniors receiving the low-middle-income senior allowance at the 1.5× tier

type2.zh: 第二類：非第一類，但符合中低收入老人生活津貼第5條第1項第2款，或領有身心障礙者生活補助者
type2.en: Type 2: receives the low-middle-income senior allowance at the 1.5–2.5× tier, or the disability living allowance

copay._note: Type 1 includes 中低收入戶 (mid-low income HOUSEHOLDS) at 0%. Proof of status comes from the district office; the change of category applies from the day the care plan is updated.

rule.zh: 聘僱外籍家庭看護工(或依其他法令不得重複領取照顧服務補助者)：照顧及專業服務額度給付30%，且只能用於居家照顧服務以外的組合(專業服務、日間照顧、家庭托顧、到宅沐浴車等)
rule.en: Households employing a foreign caregiver (or anyone barred by other laws from double care subsidies): 30% of the care & professional cap, usable only for services OTHER than in-home aide care (professional services, day care, family day care, mobile bathing, etc.)

also_available.zh: 交通接送、輔具及居家無障礙改善、喘息服務(外看請假休息時)、社區式交通接送、巷弄長照站、失智共照中心及據點、家庭照顧者支持服務
also_available.en: Transport, devices and home modification, respite (when the caregiver is on leave), community transport, neighborhood care stations, dementia centers, family caregiver support

care_gap_full_access.zh: 以下空窗期出示證明，視同未聘外看，可使用含居家服務在內的全部長照服務：申請外看期間、外看行蹤不明、轉換雇主、期滿離境、外看請假返鄉
care_gap_full_access.en: During these gaps (with proof), the household is treated as having no foreign caregiver and can use ALL services including in-home aides: while applying for a caregiver, caregiver missing, changing employer, contract ended and caregiver left, caregiver on home leave

home_services_not_applicable.zh: 全日住宿式服務及團體家屋使用者不適用本辦法(居家/社區服務)，改適用住宿式補助
home_services_not_applicable.en: People living full-time in a residential facility or group home do not use the home/community benefits above; the residential subsidy applies instead

amount.zh: 每人每月最高15,000元、每年最高180,000元(115年起，分2期撥付)
amount.en: Up to NT$15,000 per month, max NT$180,000 per year (from 2026, paid in 2 installments, reviewed in July and January)

eligible.zh: 長照需要等級第4級以上，或持中度以上身心障礙證明；112年1月1日前已入住之既有住民每月5,000元(年最高6萬)
eligible.en: Care-need level 4+, or a moderate-or-higher disability certificate. Residents already living there before 2023-01-01 who don't meet this get NT$5,000/month (max NT$60,000/year)

month_counting.zh: 當月實際入住達該月日數一半以上始計1個月；住院達半個月則該月不計；喘息入住天數不計
month_counting.en: A month counts only if the person actually stayed at least half the days; if hospitalized for half the month or more, that month doesn't count; respite stays don't count

no_double.zh: 同月不得同時領取：身心障礙者住宿式照顧費用補助、中低收入失能老人機構公費安置、榮民之家公費床位、輔導會醫療機構附設護理之家公務預算補助等同性質中央補助
no_double.en: Cannot be combined in the same month with: disability residential care subsidy, publicly funded placement for low/mid-income disabled seniors, veterans' home public beds, or similar central-government subsidies

disability_topup.zh: 領身障住宿式照顧費用補助且持中度以上身障證明者，另有每月5,000元加碼
disability_topup.en: People receiving the disability residential subsidy with a moderate+ certificate get an extra NT$5,000/month top-up

how_to_apply.zh: 入住後才能申請；115年申請自9月14日起，9月30日前入住者可申請至12月16日；向最近入住機構所在縣市申請；已核定者同年不需重新申請
how_to_apply.en: Apply only after moving in. 2026 applications opened 2026-09-14; residents admitted before 2026-09-30 can apply until 2026-12-16. Apply to the county where the facility is. Already-approved residents don't need to reapply in the same year

not_eligible_facilities.zh: 輕度身障、僅日間或夜間型住宿、康復之家、慢性精神病床不適用
not_eligible_facilities.en: Not for mild disability, day-only or night-only stays, halfway houses, or chronic psychiatric beds

tax_deduction.zh: 長期照顧特別扣除額：自114年1月1日起每人每年定額扣除18萬元(符合資格且未被所得稅法排富條款排除者)
tax_deduction.en: Long-term care special tax deduction: NT$180,000 per person per year from 2025 (if eligible and not excluded by the income tax law's high-income rule)

hotlines.zh: 臺北市長期照顧管理中心
新北市長期照顧管理中心

hotlines.en: Ministry of Labor hotline (multilingual, for migrant workers and employers)

unverified_or_varies: Whether the respite year is the calendar year or counted from approval (ask 1966)
Moving to another city: the A-unit case manager files a change form and the old center transfers the case to the new city's center (respite page)
Assessment waiting time outside discharge planning (not officially published)
